Name: Cooking Menu Filters
Author: Murgonja
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod provides similar QoL improvements as the Better Crafting mod, except it only affects the Cooking Menu, and all filtering options are available "out of the box" on the UI. You can filter the menu so it shows only:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Known recipes[/b] (so you don't get cluttered with unknown ones),[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Either [b]Food with buffs [/b]or [b]Food without buffs[/b],[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Uncooked food[/b] (useful if you are aiming for perfection and only want to see food you never cooked),[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Loved gifts[/b] (if selected, hovering over recipes will also show which NPCs love that food. It shows up only if you already know that a certain NPC loves that kind of food),[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Certain buffs that you select on the UI (For example, you can select [b]Speed[/b] and [b]Luck[/b] in order to only see recipes that provide these buffs),[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Food with the specified [b]Duration[/b] (in minutes), [b]Energy[/b],[b] [/b]or [b]Health [/b](or greater than the entered value) - useful if you are looking only for high-duration food or food that provides a lot of health for example.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]All these filters can be saved by checking the [b]Keep Filters [/b]option and they will be automatically applied upon opening the Cooking Menu.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]It is also possible to search for food using a [b]Search Bar[/b]. Just enter the food name and the menu will immediately be filtered. The Search Bar can be auto-focused on opening the Cooking Menu by selecting the [b]Auto-focus[/b] checkbox. Additionally, if you want to keep the text in the Search Bar after closing and reopening the Cooking Menu, you can check the [b]Keep search text[/b] checkbox. To delete all Search Bar contents (without having to repeatedly hit the backspace button), you can simply click the Delete button on your keyboard.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]On the right side of the Cooking Menu, you can sort recipes by Name, Buff Duration, Energy, Health, or any other buff that the food provides - in either ascending or descending order.[/color]

At the bottom of the Cooking Menu, you can prevent the usage of Qi Seasoning either by selecting [b]From inventory only[/b] (which will prevent the usage of seasoning from the fridge) or [b]Never[/b] (which completely prevents the usage of seasoning on food).

[color=#d4d4d8]This mod should be compatible with other mods that add new NPCs and new types of food.[/color]

If you want to use this mod alongside the Better Crafting mod, make sure to uncheck "Replace Cooking Menu" in the Better Crafting mod settings (This is called "ReplaceCooking" in the config.json file).
